description.text:
A top-four deck of the Senior Division at the 2013 World Championships and a deck of control: it locks the opponent's Active Pokémon in place, stops their Item cards, and spreads damage onto the Bench with Accelgor, Gothitelle, Dusknoir and Mew-EX. The 2013 World Championships were held at the Vancouver Convention Centre in Vancouver, Canada, from 9 to 11 August 2013, the first outside the United States.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2013 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a deck box and a pin. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
